description: Source code for handling Git trailers, including parsing, formatting, and applying trailers in commit messages and files.

classes.name: trailer_block
classes.description: Represents a block of trailers parsed from a commit message or text, including start/end positions and trailer entries.

classes.name: conf_info
classes.description: Configuration info for trailer parsing, including key, command, position, and existence conditions.

classes.name: trailer_item
classes.description: Represents a single trailer line with token and value.

classes.name: arg_item
classes.description: Represents a trailer argument with associated configuration.

classes.name: trailer_iterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing trailers in a message.

methods.name: trailer_block_get
methods.description: Creates a trailer_block structure from a string, identifying trailer lines.

methods.name: parse_trailers
methods.description: Parses trailers from a string into a list of trailer items.

methods.name: free_trailers
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for trailers list.

methods.name: trailer_block_start
methods.description: Returns the start position of a trailer block.

methods.name: trailer_block_end
methods.description: Returns the end position of a trailer block.

methods.name: blank_line_before_trailer_block
methods.description: Checks if there is a blank line before the trailer block.

methods.name: trailer_block_release
methods.description: Releases memory for a trailer block.

methods.name: format_trailers
methods.description: Formats trailers into a string buffer according to options.

methods.name: format_trailers_from_commit
methods.description: Formats trailers from a commit message into a string buffer.

methods.name: trailer_iterator_init
methods.description: Initializes a trailer iterator for a message.

methods.name: trailer_iterator_advance
methods.description: Advances the trailer iterator to the next trailer.

methods.name: trailer_iterator_release
methods.description: Releases resources used by the trailer iterator.

methods.name: amend_file_with_trailers
methods.description: Applies trailers to a file in-place using a command.
